mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset (id, owner_id, template_id, original_name, storage_key, content_type, size_bytes, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{ownerId}, #{templateId}, #{originalName}, #{storageKey}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, owner_id, template_id, original_name, storage_key, content_type, size_bytes, created_at FROM asset WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_id = #{ownerId}
